name_reason: Name accurately reflects behavior (set a char's facing toward a target). Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>; descriptor is meaningful; no Ghidra address residue.
purpose: Set the actor unit's facing direction (sprite_state[1]) so it looks toward a target unit, based on relative grid position.
logic_summary: actor=runtime[actor_idx], target=runtime[target_idx]. abs_dx=abs(actor.pos_x-target.pos_x), abs_dy=abs(actor.pos_y-target.pos_y). If abs_dx<=abs_dy (vertical dominates or tie -> prefer vertical): facing = (target.pos_y<actor.pos_y)?2(up):0(down). Else (horizontal dominates): facing = (target.pos_x<actor.pos_x)?1(left):3(right). Facing encoding 0=down,1=left,2=up,3=right matches fd2_paint_char_sprite_at_world_with_mode.

params.name: param_1
params.semantics: Index into data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr of the unit whose facing is being set (the actor). Source already names it actor_idx.
params.reason: Live Ghidra name param_1 is a generic placeholder; actor_idx (already used in src) describes the unit whose facing is written.

params.name: param_2
params.semantics: Index into data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr of the unit to face toward (the target). Source already names it target_idx.
params.reason: Live Ghidra name param_2 is a generic placeholder; target_idx (already used in src) describes the unit whose position drives the facing direction.

returns.semantics: No return value; side effect is writing actor->sprite_state[1] (facing byte at struct +0x03).

notes: Source (battle.c:215-235) matches decompilation exactly via runtime_char struct (types.h): pos_x@+0,pos_y@+1,sprite_state[3]@+2 so sprite_state[1]=facing@+3. Caller fd2_execute_ai_physical_attack confirms arg order: face_char_toward_target(actor,target); on counter-attack args swap to (target,actor) so target faces back. reads_globals and writes_globals both list the runtime char array because the function reads positions and writes the facing byte of the same array. Comment (src + Ghidra plate) already accurate and concise; left unchanged. Parameter renames recorded only (applied in Stage 2).
